topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: It's quiet this evening, and I find myself holding a small, wrapped gift, a bit worn from the journey it took to get here. The note is simple, a few words from a student I remember so well, thanking me for the time we spent together. The gift itself is thoughtful—a book, the pages filled with stories not so different from our own. As I leaf through the pages, my mind wanders back to those days, the laughter, the struggles, the small victories we celebrated. It’s a reminder of the time that’s passed, of the paths that have diverged. The room feels colder, and I realize how much I miss those moments, the connection we once shared. I place the book on my shelf, next to my other treasures, and wonder how we all are, out there in the world we prepared them to face.
